title: Amazon’s new AI shopping tool tells you why you should buy a recommended product
description: Amazon's new Help Me Decide tool will show you a personalized recommendation for a particular category and list reasons why you should buy it.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Snapchat makes its first open prompt AI Lens available for free in the US
description: Snapchat is expanding access to its AI-powered “Imagine Lens,” allowing all users to generate and edit images with custom prompts for free.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Why Cohere’s ex-AI research lead is betting against the scaling race
description: Cohere's former VP of AI research, Sara Hooker, is launching a new startup to build AI models that can adapt to their environment.
author: Maxwell Zeff

title: OpenAI requested memorial attendee list in ChatGPT suicide lawsuit
description: The new information comes as the Raines family updated its lawsuit against OpenAI. The family first filed a wrongful death suit against OpenAI in August after alleging their son had taken his own life following conversations with the chatbot about his mental health and suicidal ideation.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: OpenAI’s Atlas is more about ChatGPT than the web
description: OpenAI's new browser is a surface for the company to distribute ChatGPT and develop new AI features rather than improving core web experience.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Amazon unveils AI smart glasses for its delivery drivers
description: Amazon likely hopes that the new glasses will shave valuable time off of each delivery by providing delivery drivers with detailed directions and information about hazards directly in their line of sight.
author: Aisha Malik

title: GM is bringing Google Gemini-powered AI assistant to cars in 2026
description: GM is the latest automaker to lean into generative AI-based assistants that promise to respond to driver requests in a more natural-sounding way. Stellantis is collaborating with French AI firm Mistral, Mercedes is integrating ChatGPT, and Tesla has brought xAI’s Grok to its vehicles.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Meta cuts 600 AI jobs amid ongoing reorganization
description: Meta continues to restructure its AI efforts after poaching more than 50 researchers from competing labs this summer.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: GM to introduce eyes-off, hands-off driving system in 2028
description: GM said Cruise’s technology stack, including its AI models trained on five million driverless miles and simulation framework, feed directly into the automaker’s next-generation driver assistance and autonomy programs.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Last-minute TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 deal: Save 60% on your plus-one’s pass before doors open on October 27
description: Five days left until TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 kicks off in San Francisco. Buy your pass to save up to $444, plus get 60% off a second ticket. Save now.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Several users reportedly complain to FTC that ChatGPT is causing psychological harm
description: At least seven people have complained to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission that ChatGPT caused them to experience severe delusions, paranoia and emotional crises, Wired reported.
author: Ram Iyer

title: David Sacks’ Craft leads $42M Series A in govtech startup Starbridge
description: Starbridge raises $42M Series A led by Craft Ventures to help businesses better monitor public service opportunities.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: The last-minute pass savings are on! Only 5 days until TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 ignites the startup world
description: Five days until the startup conference in San Francisco kicks off. Save up to $444 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 pass, plus 60% on your guest's. This is where 10,000 tech leaders and VCs converge from October 27-29.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Sumble emerges from stealth with $38.5M to bring AI-powered context to sales intelligence
description: The founders of machine learning community Kaggle are trying to upend the crowded sales prospecting market with AI. And they're making headway.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Shuttle raises $6M to fix vibe-coding’s deployment problem
description: The platform engineering startup Shuttle announced $6 million in seed funding to handle the infrastructure problems that start where products like Lovable and Cursor leave off.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Netflix goes ‘all in’ on generative AI as entertainment industry remains divided
description: Netflix is using AI for special effects and pre-production, but CEO Ted Sarandos that Netflix "not worried about AI replacing creativity."
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Open source agentic startup LangChain hits $1.25B valuation
description: As TechCrunch previously reported, the maker of a popular open source framework for building AI agents has officially become a unicorn.
author: Julie Bort

title: Sesame, the conversational AI startup from Oculus founders, raises $250M and launches beta
description: Former Oculus CEO Brendan Iribe’s new startup, Sesame, is building AI-powered smartglasses with natural, humanlike voice interaction. Backed by Sequoia and Spark, the company also launched an invite-only iOS beta to preview its conversational AI.
author: Sarah Perez

title: OpenAI’s new browser is a broadside shot at Google
description: OpenAI's new browser announcement made it clear exactly how much Google has to lose in the AI era.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Sources: Multimodal AI startup Fal AI already raised at $4B+ valuation
description: Fal provides developers with over 600 image, video, audio, and 3D models, it says, and boasts that its cloud has thousands of Nvidia H100 and H200 GPUs and is fine-tuned for speedy inference.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince is pushing UK regulator to unbundle Google’s search and AI crawlers
description: Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince is urging regulators to rein in Google’s AI practices, arguing the tech giant’s dominance in search gives it an unfair edge in the AI race.
author: Sarah Perez

title: I spent a month living with a $430 AI pet, the Casio Moflin
description: Casio’s Moflin, a hamster-like robot pet, uses AI to develop a personality over time.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: As the browser wars heat up, here are the hottest alternatives to Chrome and Safari in 2025
description: We’ve compiled an overview of some of the top alternative browsers available today aiming to challenge Chrome and Safari.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: a16z-backed Codi launches AI agent office manager
description: The startup released its beta version of the new AI office management product in May and officially launched it on Tuesday. The company last raised a $16 million Series A in 2022 led by a16z, and has raised $23 million to date.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: OpenAI launches an AI-powered browser: ChatGPT Atlas
description: OpenAI is launching an AI-powered browser, its latest challenge to Google as the main way people find information online.
author: Maxwell Zeff

title: YouTube’s likeness-detection technology has officially launched
description: YouTube’s detection technology identifies and manages AI-generated content featuring the likeness of creators, such as their face and voice.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: WhatsApp and Messenger add new warnings to help older people avoid online scams
description: WhatsApp will now warn users before sharing their screen with unknown contacts, and Messenger will flag suspicious messages using AI.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Serval raises $47M to bring AI agents to IT service management
description: Serval is using agentic AI models to automate IT service management, but the company has a unique approach that takes advantage of agentic AI’s powers while avoiding many of its pitfalls.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Anthropic CEO claps back after Trump officials accuse firm of AI fear-mongering
description: Amodei’s response comes after last week’s dogpiling on Anthropic from AI leaders and top members of the Trump administration, including AI czar David Sacks and White House senior policy advisor for AI Sriram Krishnan -- all accusing the AI giant of stoking fears to damage the industry.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: The full TechCrunch Disrupt Stage revealed: Where the future of tech breaks first
description: The Disrupt Stage, only at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025, is where tech’s biggest bets get made, live and unfiltered.
author: TechCrunch Events
